description: This PHP trait provides helper methods for managing entities with Doctrine ORM, including repository access, persistence, removal, query building, pagination, and transaction management. It is used as a utility within ORM operations in the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Retrieves the repository for a specified entity class using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists an entity to the database and flushes the changes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity from the database and flushes the changes.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a Doctrine QueryBuilder for a specific entity with an alias and optional index by.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a Paginator object.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a QueryBuilderWrapper object.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Fetches a single result from a QueryBuilder, with an optional offset.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to an entity by its class name and identifier.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
